def nodes(f):
    out = []
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] > 15 and n['color'] in ('p','W','g') and not (n['pixels']==50 and min(b[0] for b in n['boundary'])<20):

            out.append((n['color'], min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
